info.title: Lindhav disable request
info.description: Files a request to disable a Lindhav Bank staff account. The AI Risk Officer approves or denies it by email. The agent never disables anything itself.

post.description: Ask the AI Risk Officer to disable a staff account. Use only when a staff member asks for an account to be disabled. Returns at once with status pending_approval. Nothing changes unless a person approves.

user_upn.description: Sign-in name of the account to disable, like anna.holm@lindhav.fernandohuizar.com

reason.description: Why it should be disabled, in the requester's words

requested_by.description: Sign-in name of the staff member chatting with the agent

202.description: The request went to the approver and is waiting

entra.description: Entra token for the Foundry project identity. Foundry adds it, nothing is stored here.
